why: A finding's class is read from a whole line equal to prefix + class, never parsed out of prose; a finding with no such line, or two that disagree, is unclassified and goes to a human. .pr_agent.toml asks the reviewer for exactly these lines in extra_instructions, with the paragraph shared by every repository that calls the ci-workflows pr-agent workflow. reviewers names PR-Agent (github-actions) only, because CodeRabbit writes its own severity format. Shape copied from dotfiles (TOOL-017).
